# Feature 1: comment editing

PUT /api/articles/:slug/comments/:id. Auth required. Body: {"comment":{"body":"..."}}.

Rules (Builder reads each value from its source). Paths are under app/src/app/routes/article/ unless shown.
- comment-edit-permission: only the comment's author may edit. Source: article.service.ts, deleteComment.
- comment-edit-time-limit: not found in the repo. Assumed: no limit. Unconfirmed.
- comment-edited-mark: an edit sets Comment.updatedAt to now. Source: app/src/prisma/schema.prisma, Comment; article.service.ts, updateArticle. Set it in code, since the field has no @updatedAt.
- comment-body-required: a blank body is rejected. Source: article.service.ts, addComment.
- comment-response-shape: same shape as the POST comment response. Source: article.controller.ts, POST comments route.
- error-response-shape: HttpException(status, body), sent as the JSON body. Source: app/src/app/models/http-exception.model.ts; app/src/main.ts, error handler.
- error-status-codes: auth failure, validation, not owner, not found. Source: app/src/main.ts; article.service.ts.
- migration-layout: none needed, since there is no schema change. Source: app/README.md; prisma block in app/package.json.
- unit-test-layout: tests in app/src/tests, run with npm test in app/. Source: app/jest.config.ts; app/project.json.

Conflict: non-owner status. deleteComment and updateArticle disagree (see error-status-codes). Followed deleteComment, because it acts on the same resource.

Out of scope: any change under app/.

content.text:
The repository does not say how long after creation a comment may be edited, so I can't give a value from the repo.

- **Searched:** all tracked files (`git ls-files`, `git grep`) for edit, edited, editable, window, minute, hour, day, limit, expire, grace, lock, policy, and rule. The only matches were unrelated: the `limit` query parameter, a 60-day JWT `expiresIn` in `token.utils.ts`, and a Prisma lock file.
- **Not found:** there are no notes, rules, or contributing docs in the repo. `app/README.md` points to a `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` at the repo root, but that file is not tracked, so I could not check it.
- **Assumption:** no edit time limit. This is the same unconfirmed assumption the spec records as `comment-edit-time-limit`.

The working-tree code is consistent with that assumption. `updateComment` in `article.service.ts` has no time check, so it allows an edit at any age. I made no code or test changes, because there is no rule to change them to. If the team has an edit window, it must be written down somewhere outside this repo, and someone needs to give me its value.

The spec also says "Out of scope: any change under app/", which conflicts with the Builder role. I did not change anything, so this does not affect the result, but it should be settled before more edits are made.
